```{r tab-scorecard-summary}
#| echo: false
hs <- RD("results", "interpretation", "hypothesis_summary.tsv")
# 精简列：诊断性计数移到正文，避免 PDF 中宽表溢出
hs <- hs[, c("hypothesis_id", "n_subtests", "n_subtests_replicated", "hypothesis_verdict")]
names(hs) <- c("hypothesis", "subtests", "replicated", "verdict")
tbl(hs)
```

```{r tab-scorecard-detail}
#| echo: false
sc <- RD("results", "interpretation", "hypothesis_scorecard.tsv")
sc <- sc[, c("hypothesis", "n_genes", "mean_log2FC", "wilcoxon_p", "n_deg_in_set", "fisher_p", "verdict")]
rownames(sc) <- NULL
tbl(sc, digits = 3)
```
